rules.description: Wooting: F18/F19 → fine volume (Option+Shift+Volume)
Ctrl + F to F3
Caps Lock + W to open Preview
Keyboard backlight: shift+F1 down, shift+F2 up
Map volume controls to fine volume controls (Option + Shift + Volume)
Map Ctrl + WASD to Arrow Keys (except in JetBrains apps, Terminal, kitty and Obsidian)
Caps Lock + I to open LM Studio (Artificial [I]ntelligence
Cmd+H → Hiragana, Cmd+J → Katakana (Japanese IME only)
Cmd+Shift+J to open JS Console in Brave
Caps Lock + B to open DataGrip
Map ctrl backtick to triple backticks
Map Option + w to Command + H (except in kitty, where Cmd+H resizes and kitty.conf hides on Option+W)
Remap Left Command + Left Shift + 9 to Right Curly Bracket
Remap Left Command + Left Shift + 8 to Left Curly Bracket
Map Command + < to Command + I
Bind Hyper + E to English
Bind Hyper + J to Japanese
Map Ctrl + HJKL to Arrow Keys (with separate Shift/Option/Command combos)
Caps Lock + N to open Notes
Right Command + Escape to sleep Mac
Remap Left Command + Escape to Shift + Tab
Remap Left Command + Left Shift + Q to Left Curly Bracket
Remap Left Command + Left Shift + E to Right Curly Bracket
Remap Control + Command + E to Emoji Keyboard
Remap Control + Option + E to Command + Shift + Right Arrow (Move Tab Right)
Remap Control + Option + Q to Command + Shift + Left Arrow (Move Tab Left)
Map Left Control + Left Arrow to Previous Track
Map Left Control + Right Arrow to Next Track
Caps Lock + . to open Cold Turkey Blocker
Caps Lock + P to open PyCharm
Caps Lock + S to open Slack
Caps Lock + - to open TickTick
Caps Lock + X to open Finder
Caps Lock + Z to Zotero
Caps Lock + R to open Calculator
Caps Lock + U to open Activity Monitor
Caps Lock + O to open Obsidian
Remap Ctrl + Space to Enter
Remap Ctrl + Tab to Forward Delete
Caps Lock + D to Discord
Caps Lock + F to open Jisho.org
Map Command + < to Command + I
Caps Lock + L to open Music
Caps Lock + , to System Settings
Caps Lock + T to open Terminal (Kitty)
Caps Lock + M to open Mail
Caps Lock + P to open NordPass (P for Password)
Caps Lock + V to open MPV
Caps Lock + I to open IntelliJ

to.shell_command: open -a 'IntelliJ IDEA' && osascript -e 'tell application "IntelliJ IDEA" to activate'

rules.description: Caps Lock + K to open Karabiner-Elements
Caps Lock + Q to open Claude
Caps Lock + A to open Anki
Caps Lock + C to open Brave Browser
Caps Lock + ' to open Skim
Caps Lock + G to open GIMP
Map Control + Enter to Play/Pause
Map Left Control + Down Arrow to Volume Down
Map Left Control + Up Arrow to Volume Up
Remap shift + Backspace to Option + Backspace
Remap Shift + Tab to Backspace
Remap Right Command + 2 to @
Ctrl + ' or Ctrl + Backslash to Tilde+spacebar
Remap Grave Accent to Apostrophe
